summary: This study aims to investigate the etiology of keratoconus (KC) using a murine model exposed to ultraviolet radiation and a novel cornea-on-a-chip model. The murine model, based on a gene-trap and knockin mouse model of Ppip5k2, a gene of interest in KC, will be exposed to combined UVA and UVB radiation to induce KC-like characteristics. The cornea-on-a-chip model will study the interaction of corneal epithelial and stromal cells, including the effects of inflammatory factors, to understand KC-related genetic, inflammatory, and biomechanical factors and their interactions.
